counting_policy: Conservative effective multiplicity count. Executed formulas, suggested or rejected formulas, ineligible explanatory controls, diagnostics eligible for narrative comparison, aborted attempts, and audited reruns all count.

not_counted_in_primary_family.risk_matched_spy_paths: Deterministically derived benchmark paths, one per candidate; not selectable formulas.
not_counted_in_primary_family.aegis_q_legacy_auxiliary: External strategy replication on a different data and execution panel; never eligible for the Generation 6 primary selection.

claim_boundary: All Generation 6 formulas are chosen after all historical intervals, the 105 prior trials, and the Generation 4/5 outcomes were seen. Hash freezing prevents result-driven rewriting of this batch but cannot create a pristine holdout, prove alpha, establish options P&L, or predict future profitability.
